product.name: Monoprice Blackbird 4K60 4x2 Video Matrix with HDMI Supprts Coaxial Audio HDR HDCP 2.2 YCbCr 444
product.description: This Blackbird™ 4K 4x2 HDMI® Matrix allows you to distribute any of four HDMI sources to either or both connected displays. It fully complies with the HDMI 2.0b and HDCP™ 2.2 and 1.4 specifications. It supports video resolutions up to 4K@60Hz with the YCbCr 4:4:4 color space. It can extract the audio from either output and send it to the digital optical S/PDIF and stereo analog audio outputs. It can upscale 1080p video to 4K and downscale 4K video to 1080p. It supports the Audio Return Channel (ARC) feature and includes an IR remote control. It features EDID® management and supports up to 18Gbps bandwidth.
